meta.name: alterlab-scvi-tools
meta.description: Train deep generative models for single-cell omics with scvi-tools — probabilistic batch correction and integration (scVI), reference-mapping transfer learning (scArches), differential expression with uncertainty, and multimodal models (totalVI for CITE-seq, MultiVI for multiome). Use when correcting batch effects, integrating multimodal data, or doing advanced probabilistic single-cell modeling — for standard analysis pipelines use scanpy. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 用概率模型分析单细胞组学数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理单细胞测序数据，需要校正批次效应或整合多模态数据。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze single-cell omics data with probabilistic models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are working with single-cell sequencing data and need batch correction or multimodal integration.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 scvi-tools 训练深度生成模型，分析单细胞数据，包括批次校正、多模态整合、差异表达等。
howto.when: 当你要求分析单细胞 RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 或多模态数据，或进行批次校正、细胞类型注释时触发。

say.text: 用 scVI 对这个单细胞数据集做批次校正和降维。
say.note: 运行 scVI 模型，输出校正后的潜在表示。

say.text: 用 totalVI 分析 CITE-seq 的 RNA 和蛋白数据。
say.note: 运行 totalVI 模型，联合建模 RNA 和蛋白。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can train deep generative models with scvi-tools for single-cell data analysis, including batch correction, multimodal integration, and differential expression.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze single-cell RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, or multimodal data, or to perform batch correction or cell type annotation.

say_en.text: Use scVI for batch correction and dimensionality reduction on this single-cell dataset.
say_en.note: Runs scVI model, outputs corrected latent representation.

say_en.text: Use totalVI to analyze CITE-seq RNA and protein data.
say_en.note: Runs totalVI model, jointly models RNA and protein.

say_en.text: Use scANVI for semi-supervised cell type annotation.
say_en.note: Runs scANVI model, uses partial labels for annotation.
